entities.name: IMEISV
entities.description: The IMEISV (International Mobile Equipment Identity and Software Version) information element containing equipment identity and software version information.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: A security mode command message used to activate integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: IMEISV requested
entities.description: Condition where the IMEISV information element was specifically requested in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

relations.description: The SECURITY MODE COMMAND message may contain a request for the IMEISV information element.
If the IMEISV was requested in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message, the UE shall include the IMEISV information element.
